title: HB's Satellites Compatability Mod
description: Compatability layer between HB's Satellites and other popular mod like Create Big Cannons, Aeronautics, Eshan's Missile mods
body:
# HB's Satellite Compat Mod

Compatability layer mod which adds support between HB's Satellites and **several** non-required weaponry and information mods including:

[Base Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/hbs-satellites)

### [Create: Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons) (>=5.11.2)

- Allows players to use the Target Controller and Target receiver blocks to orient the Cannon Mount towards a target location
- The Cannon itself needs to be loaded or it will not target correctly as the Cannon's power is determined by the current munitions

To use:
1. Place a Target Controller next to the array grid of Satellite Display Blocks which are powered on and connected to a Satellite
2. Place a Target Receiver Block directly next to the Cannon Mount Block, this can be anywhere in the world that is chunk loaded
3. Build the Cannon, load the Cannon, and construct the cannon with a redstone signal
4. Use the "target" button on the Target Controller to start the targeting process
5. Right Click any location on the Satellite holo-display to set the target - the cannon will orient itself towards the target automatically
6. You can fire the cannon anyway you like, or use the "fire" button on the Target Controller


### [Eshan's Missiles](https://modrinth.com/mod/eshans-missile-mod) **(NOT IMPLEMENTED YET)**
- Setting a target receiver block next to a Missile Silo will feed target position to Missile Silo
- Firing from Target Controller will trigger Missile launch from Silo

### [Create: Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics) **(NOT IMPLEMENTED YET)**
- Allows players to view Airships on the Satellite display
- Target Receiver can send target destination Block Position to the Navigator block
